actualSql:
SELECT SUM(INVOICE.[NETTOTAL]) AS satis_tutari
FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
referenceSql: SELECT SUM(NETTOTAL) AS retail_sales FROM dbo.LG_411_01_INVOICE WHERE TRCODE = 7 AND DATE_ >= '20260101' AND DATE_ < '20270101' AND CANCELLED = 0
